title: L(L+1)=240 & E8 Correspondence
concepts: L(L+1) = 240 factorizes as (L-15)(L+16) = 0, giving L = 15, L+1 = 16
15 × 16 = 240 = number of roots in canonical E8 root system
Two independent routes to 240: L(L+1) construction and E8 root count
Correspondence, not yet proof of E8 lattice — needs actual embedding/metric
key_results: L = 15, L+1 = 16 derived exactly from L(L+1) = 240
15 × 16 = 240 = |E8 roots| — two independent routes to same number
This is an exact numerical correspondence, much stronger than a numerical fit
Does NOT by itself prove the lattice is an E8 lattice — needs embedding/metric
